title: Left alignment

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Give elements a common alignment so viewers can scan a composition along a stable starting edge.
strategic_value: A preferred left edge can connect Helsinki layouts without prescribing every detail of their composition.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section states the left-alignment preference and shows orange Helsinki Energy Challenge text with a common left edge.
practical_value: Start with left-aligned text and visual elements when arranging a city communication.

content_islands.name: Energy Challenge specimen
content_islands.spec: Show the large Process and timetable heading above smaller orange text, all sharing a left edge.

ingredient.name: Left alignment
ingredient.application: Prefer left alignment for visual elements and align text left.
ingredient.scope: The source calls this a preferred approach, not a universal prohibition on every centered composition.

reference_purposes.Application: The example demonstrates left-aligned text and visual elements.
